status.en: 17 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 143% more than the week before, most of them in Mogadishu, Puntland and Baidoa.
status.nb: 17 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 143 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Mogadishu, Puntland og Baidoa.

summary.en: Fitgharan forces continue to hold the Mogadishu-Baidoa corridor while Laftagareen forces have captured Buurhakaba and opposition fighters have taken a third town in the Bay region, intensifying local fighting. Ethiopia is reported to be supporting al-Shabaab militants in the Southwest State and is planning a withdrawal of more than 3,000 troops from Somalia as its own internal conflict escalates. Somalia is screening travelers after Kenya confirmed an imported Ebola case and is deepening defence ties with Pakistan by agreeing to acquire JF‑17 fighter jets. The ICRC says 148 wounded were treated after heavy fighting in Baidoa, and there were 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Fitgharan-styrkene fortsetter å holde koridoren mellom Mogadishu og Baidoa, mens Laftagareen-styrkene har erobret Buurhakaba og opposisjonskrigere har tatt en tredje by i Bay-regionen, noe som intensiverer de lokale kampene. Etiopia skal støtte al-Shabaab-militante i Southwest State og planlegger å trekke tilbake mer enn 3 000 soldater fra Somalia ettersom den interne konflikten i landet eskalerer. Somalia screener reisende etter at Kenya bekreftet et importert ebolatilfelle, og landet utdyper forsvarssamarbeidet med Pakistan ved å bli enige om å anskaffe JF‑17‑jagerfly. IKT sier at 148 sårede ble behandlet etter harde kamper i Baidoa, og at det var 2 284 døde i kamprelaterte hendelser i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Somali Civil War (2009–present)
background.extract: The ongoing phase of the Somali Civil War began in 2009 and is concentrated in southern and central Somalia, primarily between the forces of the Federal Government of Somalia (FGS), assisted by African Union peacekeeping forces, and the Islamist militant group al-Shabaab, which pledged allegiance to al-Qaeda in 2012.
